jupas.nameEn: Bachelor of Arts and Sciences in Global Health and Development
jupas.shortDescription: an class="before_label">Short Description The BASc(GHD) help students develop the foundational multidisciplinary and international perspectives, the core blocks of knowledge and the people and systems oriented competencies needed to succeed in modern health and development related fields. The curriculum combines: Basic to intermediate level courses across multiple Faculties (Architecture, Business and Economics, Law, Medicine, Science, Social Sciences) Advanced seminars and case studies Placements in local/overseas health and development organisations Mentoring on career choices and leadership BASc courses on leadership and big data analytics A distinctive feature of the programme is a compulsory capstone, during which students will be placed in leading health and development organisations such as UN agencies, Non-governmental Organisations (NGOs), contract research organization (CRO), philanthropic foundations, etc., for a 6-month experience facilitated by HKU.
